summary: 80-foot Aermotor LS-40 tower at Appleton, Allendale County; sold by the state in the 1990s, moved and rebuilt at a private location. Same tower as us-sc-appleton-bramlett.

facts.design: Aermotor LS-40 steel tower, 80 ft, with 7 by 7 foot cab
facts.status_note: The 2013 register entry shows the tower reconstructed at its new site. No source read confirms its condition today.

access.note: Moved to a private location after the state sold it; no public access found.

events.note: Register's Built field gives 1930; its description says the tower was originally built near Appleton in the late 1930s
SC Forestry Commission closed its fire tower system on October 1, 1993 (system-wide closure; no separate date for this tower)

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register's Built field gives 1930, but its own description says late 1930s. The story reports both and does not pick one.
The register says the tower was bought from the state in the late 1990s; Forest Lookouts gives the year only as 199??. The story says the 1990s and no event year is written for the sale.

notes_for_editor: DUPLICATE: this is the same tower as us-sc-appleton-bramlett (NHLR calls it Appleton/Bramlett Tower; both describe an 80-foot Aermotor LS-40 at Appleton, sold by the state and moved about three miles). Written as the brief asked, but the editor should merge the two records or retire one. The build year (1930 vs late 1930s) is still open. The sibling record also cites a Facebook post calling some pictures the ruins of this tower; that post was not read here and is not used. The owner is named in the register; the story leaves the name out. Confirm the Forest Lookouts '199??' against the register before writing an exact sale year. About four page reads.
